title: BPM Cables - Flexible LMR for ALS-U
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.BERKELEY NATL LAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: Dear Prospective Offeror: The University of California, on behalf of the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL), would like to invite you to participate in Request for Quote (RFQ) No. AA-2026-05 for Flexible Cables that will be utilized in the ALS-U. The RFQ and associated documents (listed below) are attached: 0. RFQ and submission instructions 1. Statement of Work 2. Acceptance Criteria List 3. Sample Subcontract 4. Rep Cert Form (required with submission if total Quote is in excess of $150K) 5. Past Performance Reference Information Form (submit with Quote regardless of value) *With your Quote submission, you must certify in writing that you meet and agree to all of the Mandatory Requirements outlined within Doc 0. RFQ AA-2026-05 and will manufacture per SOW. Timeline of Events: RFQ Release - April 10, 2026 Quotes Due - April 23, 2026 We look forward to your participation.
